node.statement: Nodes 1.1.1 and 1.3.1 give ||[x,y]||<=10*epsilon<=10/24=5/12<2 for all contractions, contradicting node 1.3.2 if B were noncommutative. Thus B is commutative. A nonzero finite-dimensional commutative unital C*-algebra is the direct sum of its k>=1 one-dimensional minimal central ideals, so evaluation on the minimal central projections gives a unital *-isomorphism iota:l_inf^k->B.
